name: Mechanical Assembly
structure_example: System > Subsystem > Component > Part, e.g. Drivetrain > Transmission > Gear Set > Output Gear / Bearing / Shaft
function_example: Transmits rotational torque from the input shaft to the output shaft at a specified ratio with minimal backlash

failure_chains_starter.fe: Drivetrain develops noise and eventually loses torque transfer
failure_chains_starter.fm: Gear tooth pitting and premature wear
failure_chains_starter.fc: Case-hardening depth is below the design specification
failure_chains_starter.pc: Heat-treat process parameters locked via DOE; supplier PPAP requirement on case depth
failure_chains_starter.dc: Destructive case-depth sectioning at a defined sampling frequency

failure_chains_starter.fe: Bearing assembly fails prematurely in service
failure_chains_starter.fm: Bearing preload out of specification after press-fit assembly
failure_chains_starter.fc: Press force sensor drifted out of calibration
failure_chains_starter.pc: Calibration schedule for press-force sensors + SPC on press force
failure_chains_starter.dc: In-station force-displacement monitoring with automatic reject on out-of-band curves

failure_chains_starter.fe: Structural bracket fails under load, risking component detachment
failure_chains_starter.fc: Weld penetration below specification due to incorrect welding parameters
failure_chains_starter.pc: Welding parameter SOP + operator certification program
failure_chains_starter.dc: Ultrasonic weld inspection at a defined sampling frequency

special_characteristics_guidance: Load-bearing structural joints (welds, press-fits, fasteners in the load path) are the most common source of high-severity chains in this domain. Torque and press-force parameters are frequent SC candidates that belong on the control plan.
